title: Bitcoin's momentum gauge is turning red, could send prices back below $60,000
Bitcoin hits 12-week low as dollar rallies on interest-rate outlook, liquidations top $1.6 billion
summary: Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and is down 3.5% since midnight UTC, as the dollar climbs and liquidations top $1.6 billion.

title: Live news: Bitcoin plunges back towards bear market lows, wiping out late summer rally
summary: Bitcoin fell below its 200-week moving average as interest rates and the dollar surged, while equity markets shrugged off Nvidia's troubles.

title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
summary: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
summary: About 70% of the bitcoin treasury firm’s coins are pledged to the exchange, bought at roughly $118,000 each, and bitcoin now trades under $69,000.
